statement.zh: 成熟哈拉帕为统一「帝国」——学界模型之一，本条不升为定论。
statement.en: That Mature Harappan was a unified "empire" is one scholarly model — not elevated to fact here.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: empire vs urban network / political form remains open; keep in hypothesis column.
